Definition: properly, to make mouths at, i.e. to scoff; hence (from the effort to pronounce a foreign language) to interpret, or (generally) intercede
BiblicalUsage: 1) to scorn, make mouths at, talk arrogantly; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to boast; 1a2) to scorn; 1b) (Hiphil); 1b1) to mock, deride; 1b2) to interpret (language); 1b2a) interpreter (participle); 1b2b) ambassador (fig.); 1c) (Hithpalpel) to be inflated, scoff, act as a scorner, show oneself a mocker
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
